content.text: In countries like Zimbabwe, where financial isolation and platform restrictions are a harsh reality, deploying a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free seems like an insurmountable challenge. However, with the right infrastructure, you can overcome these obstacles and start selling your digital products to a global audience. This guide will walk you through the process of setting up a digital store on Cloudflare Pages, using Stack 01 or Stack 02, and accepting crypto payments with NOWPayments.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The key to a successful digital store lies in its infrastructure. By using a combination of free tools like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you can create a robust and scalable digital commerce stack. This infrastructure is not only free but also provides you with full data ownership and control, allowing you to operate independently of restrictive platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your digital store, you need to have a clear understanding of your products, target audience, and marketing strategy. You also need to set up a NOWPayments account, which will enable you to accept crypto payments with a 0.5% fee. Additionally, you need to choose between Stack 01 and Stack 02, depending on your specific needs and technical expertise. Stack 01 is a simpler solution that uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, while Stack 02 is a more advanced solution that uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Once you have set up your store's infrastructure, you need to configure your payment and delivery pipeline. This involves integrating NOWPayments with your store, setting up automatic payment verification, and configuring your product delivery system. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, and with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate your payment and delivery processes, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers.
Use Stack 01 for a simpler solution with GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After you have set up your store's infrastructure and payment pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. This is an exciting moment, as you will be able to see your store in action and start generating revenue. To ensure a smooth launch, make sure to test your store thoroughly, including your payment and delivery processes, and have a plan in place for handling any issues that may arise.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your store is up and running, you can focus on scaling your business. This involves optimizing your store's performance, improving your marketing strategy, and expanding your product offerings. With the right infrastructure in place, you can scale your business quickly and efficiently, without worrying about restrictive platforms or high transaction fees.
